activity_evidence: Current official store offers the SO-ARM101 Pro assembled arm and Reachy Mini replacement shells with in-stock purchase listings, reflecting active open-source robotics supply.

products.name: SO-ARM101 Pro Assembled Kit
products.purchased_scope: Assembled articulated arm including structural printed parts, six STS3215 servos and BusLinker V3.0 controller. Optional camera is separate.
products.notes: The existing SKU 114993667 is a motor kit, not this assembled product. Designer SO-101 geometry is available; verify exact vendor revision before claiming exact matching CAD.

products.name: Body Top Shell for Reachy Mini
products.purchased_scope: Upper plastic body cover only; no motors, internal frame, controller or electronics.
products.notes: A real body-shaped shell suitable for the visual torso palette. Official designer repository includes pp01068_top_body.stl; a shell does not constitute a functioning torso.

products.name: Body Down Shell for Reachy Mini
products.purchased_scope: Lower plastic body cover only; no electronics or locomotion hardware.
products.notes: Official designer repository includes pp01067_bottom_body.stl. Lower body cover should be labelled shell, rather than sold as a complete torso.

activity_evidence: Current store lists complete RoArm-M2-S and RoArm-M3-S arm families; the official M3 support wiki links a STEP archive updated with a 260310 revision filename.

products.name: RoArm-M2-S robotic arm
products.purchased_scope: Complete articulated desktop arm with gripper and controller; select S variant and the appropriate regional power supply.
products.availability: Current official purchase listing; regional variant availability may differ.
products.notes: Price is the displayed starting price for S, not the higher-priced Pro. Official full assembly CAD archive was downloaded in this session.

products.name: RoArm-M3-S robotic arm
products.purchased_scope: Complete 5+1 degree-of-freedom arm assembly with gripper and control electronics; select S rather than Pro variant.
products.availability: Current official purchase listing; regional variant availability may differ.
products.notes: Starting price for S variant. Match the S CAD assembly inside the archive rather than an alternate revision or Pro configuration. Additional camera/AI modules are not assumed included.

activity_evidence: Official Americas store currently promotes IROS 2026 embodied-AI work and a tenth-anniversary myCobot 280 X Edition, while maintaining manufacturer CAD downloads.

products.name: myCobot 280 Pi
products.purchased_scope: Complete six-axis compact robotic arm with Raspberry Pi-based control. End-effectors and application kits are separate configuration choices.
products.availability: Current manufacturer product page; price and lead time not verified.
products.notes: Manufacturer documentation directly links this CAD file; binary download was not verified. A full articulated arm candidate rather than a servo component.

products.name: myCobot 280 M5Stack
products.purchased_scope: Complete six-axis compact robot arm with M5Stack controller. Grippers and other end-effectors are selected separately.
products.availability: Current manufacturer listing; exact purchase price and lead time unverified.
products.notes: Official download table explicitly lists a myCobot 280 M5 model. Download endpoint and model revision need checking before importing. Pi and M5 are controller variants of the same arm family.

activity_evidence: Current official store sells articulated arms alongside R1, G1 and H2 humanoids and publishes a clarification about its 2025 shipments. It lists its business address in Hangzhou, China.

products.name: Unitree Z1
products.purchased_scope: Complete articulated robotic arm; select variant and confirm included gripper, power supply and controller with seller.
products.availability: Official store listing; confirm final configuration and shipping with seller.
products.notes: Official repository contains mesh and xacro directories for Z1. Price is store listing price and may depend on commercial configuration. G1/R1 humanoids are whole robots and should not be relabelled as separately sold torsos.
